name: David B. Hoppe
tagline: Top rated Intellectual Property attorney in San Francisco, California
about: The founder & managing partner of Gamma Law, based in San Francisco, California, David B. Hoppe, provides legal counsel to clients across a broad range of business, technology and intellectual property matters. His practice encompasses intellectual property, international business transactions, media and technology licensing, venture capital financing, mergers and acquisitions, corporate governance, shareholder matters, and legal issues involving NFTs and blockchain technology. He also advises clients in the business/corporate, entertainment and sports sectors.

Mr. Hoppe works with entrepreneurs, emerging companies, investors and established businesses, offering guidance on matters that arise throughout the business life cycle. His practice includes assisting early-stage companies with formation, financing and strategic growth initiatives, as well as advising investors and companies in venture capital transactions. He also represents clients in mergers and acquisitions, helping them face difficult negotiations and transactional matters while addressing legal and business objectives.

With experience in technology-driven industries, Mr. Hoppe counsels clients on intellectual property protection, licensing arrangements and commercial agreements. He also advises businesses operating in evolving areas of innovation, including blockchain technology and digital assets. Through his work with companies in the media, entertainment and sports industries, he helps clients address legal issues related to content, technology and business operations.

A dedicated legal professional, Mr. Hoppe collaborates closely with clients to develop practical strategies tailored to their unique goals and circumstances. His international perspective and experience in cross-border matters enable him to assist clients engaged in global business activities. In addition, he is proficient in spoken and written Japanese, allowing him to effectively communicate with Japanese-speaking clients and business partners.

Mr. Hoppe completed his undergraduate studies at Loma Linda University before obtaining his Juris Doctor from Georgetown University Law Center in 1993. He was admitted to practice law in California in 1993 and in New York in 2000. He is a member of several professional organizations, including the Blockchain Game Alliance, Esports Trade Association, Inter-Pacific Bar Association, Japan Society of Northern California, Video Game Bar Association and VR/AR Association.
